اسم المشروع: Vaultspace

هو مشروع يعمل على نقل البيانات الصحية من مكان رواد الفضاء إلى المحطة عن طريق الأقمار الصناعية، ويستخدم عدة أجهزة مثل سوار لقياس نبضات القلب وجهاز لقراءة بيانات الصحية للجسم مثل كثافة العظام وجهاز لقياس الضغط ونسبة الأكسجين، يقوم بمعالجة البيانات وإرسالها إلى المحطة الأرضية.
summary:
VitaSpace is a web-based astronaut self-health monitoring system built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025 by Hanan Tamer Ibrahim (Team Leader), Abdullah Sabry Kadry (Coding Engineer), and Mr. Ayman (Presentation) from WE School for Applied Technology, Dakahlia, Egypt.

The system addresses a critical gap in deep-space missions: astronauts must monitor their own health without real-time Earth support. VitaSpace unifies 6 vital signs (heart rate, SpO₂, glucose, body temperature, cabin pressure, ambient temperature) and 8 spacecraft systems (hull, left/right wing, life support, power, comms, thermal, navigation) into a single, verifiable interface.

Unlike black-box AI, VitaSpace uses a Rule-based Expert System with transparent IF-THEN logic, ensuring every diagnosis is traceable — critical for safety-critical aerospace applications. A Windowed Delta Detection algorithm compares 5-second windows to catch rapid deterioration before static thresholds trip.

The system integrates real NASA DONKI data (5 verified Radiation Belt Enhancement events from the GOES-P satellite), which updates automatically every 5 minutes and feeds into the overall Danger Index.

The prototype runs on Python aiohttp and WebSockets, with two HMIs (Astronaut Device + Ground Station) connected via QR code. Future phases include ESP32 hardware integration, ML prediction, and Iridium satellite communication

🎯 Part 1: The Idea & Vision
What is VitaSpace?
VitaSpace is an integrated web-based system for autonomous astronaut health monitoring that helps astronauts track their health and spacecraft systems, detecting problems before they become disasters.

Why This Idea?
In deep space (Mars, Moon, orbital stations), communication with Earth is delayed (up to 20 minutes). The astronaut cannot wait for a doctor on Earth. They need a system that acts as a "personal doctor" and "spacecraft engineer" simultaneously.

The Team
Name Role
Hanan Tamer Ibrahim Team Leader & Project Coordinator
Abdullah Sabry Kadry Coding Engineer & System Architect
Mr. Ayman Presentation & Media Specialist
School: WE School for Applied Technology, Dakahlia, Egypt
Competition: NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025

🔴 Part 2: The Problem
1. Silent Deterioration
Gradual hypoxia or slow cabin leaks go unnoticed until it's too late

Vital signs change without early warning

2. Static Threshold Lag
Traditional systems alert after the value crosses the limit

Example: Pressure was 1.0 atm, dropped to 0.7 atm in 5 seconds → The system won't notice because 0.7 is still "acceptable"

3. Cognitive Overload
One screen for health, one for spacecraft, one for communications

In an emergency, the astronaut must switch between 3 screens → lost time

4. Earth Latency
Communication with Earth takes time

The astronaut cannot get an immediate decision from a ground doctor

5. No Delivery Confirmation
Critical commands can be lost

No guarantee the message arrived

💡 Part 3: The Solution
The VitaSpace Concept
One unified system that brings everything together:

Component Function
Device HMI Single screen with 6 vitals + 8 spacecraft systems + Danger Index + SOS
Station HMI Monitor all astronauts + send commands + expert analysis
Python Server (aiohttp) Real-time data transfer + NASA data + Expert System
QR Code Instant pairing between device and station
Core Features
Unified Interface — Everything on one screen

Windowed Delta Detection — Detects rapid changes before static thresholds

Rule-based Expert System — Transparent, verifiable diagnosis

Verified Communication — ACK for every message

Real NASA Data — 5 RBE events from GOES-P satellite

Automatic Updates — Every 5 minutes without user intervention

🛠️ Part 4: Programming Ideas & Technologies
1. Server (server.py)
Technology Usage
Python 3.9+ Programming language
aiohttp Async HTTP + WebSocket server
asyncio Concurrent tasks
WebSocket Real-time bidirectional connection
Session Tokens Prevent race conditions on reconnect
NASA DONKI API Space weather data
Key Programming Ideas:

A) Session Management (Race Condition Prevention)
python
session = f"{time.time()}_{id(ws)}"
old = devices.get(dev_id)
if old:
old['session'] = 'KICKED' # Invalidate old
await old['ws'].close()

devices[dev_id] = {'ws': ws, 'session': session}

# In finally:
if devices[dev_id].get('session') == session:
devices.pop(dev_id) # Remove only if still current
Problem Solved: When a Device connects twice with the same ID (two tabs, or rapid reconnect), the old session would mistakenly delete the new one → infinite Connect/Disconnect loop.

B) Broadcast to BOTH Devices and Stations
python
async def broadcast_nasa_weather():
data = await fetch_donki_data()
msg = json.dumps({"type": "nasa_weather", "data": data})

# Broadcast to STATIONS
for s in list(stations):
await s.send_str(msg)

# Broadcast to DEVICES (was missing)
for dev in devices.values():
await dev['ws'].send_str(msg)
Problem Solved: NASA data was only reaching the Station; the Device stayed at zero.

C) Expert System (Rule-based Analysis)
python
def analyze_device(dev_id):
# Logical IF-THEN rules
if hr > 150:
findings.append({
'severity': 'CRITICAL',
'system': 'HEART RATE',
'diagnosis': f'Severe tachycardia ({hr} bpm)',
'likely_cause': 'Arrhythmia or hemorrhage',
'recommendation': 'ECG + medical evaluation'
})
Advantage: Every diagnosis is traceable — not a black box like ML.

2. Frontend (device.html + station.html)
Technology Usage
HTML5 Page structure
CSS3 Sci-Fi HUD design
Vanilla JavaScript (ES6) UI logic
WebSocket API Real-time data reception
Web Audio API Alert sounds (no MP3 files)
SVG Animation Orbital rings + gauges
Key Programming Ideas:

A) Windowed Delta Detection (in Device)
javascript
// Compare last 5 seconds vs previous 5 seconds
if (history.length >= WINDOW * 2) {
var curr = history.slice(-WINDOW);
var prev = history.slice(-WINDOW*2, -WINDOW);
var ca = avgOf(curr), pa = avgOf(prev);

var dHR = Math.abs(ca.hr - pa.hr);
if (dHR > 30) score += 20; // Critical change
}
Advantage: Detects rapid deterioration before the value crosses the threshold.

B) Sudden Change Alerts
javascript
var SUDDEN_THRESHOLDS = {
hr: 20, spo2: 5, glucose: 30,
bodyTemp: 0.5, pressure: 0.15, ambientTemp: 5
};
// If change exceeds threshold → immediate alert to Station
C) HARD DAMAGE Protocol
javascript
if (pct > 30 && lastDestructionPct <= 30) {
triggerHardDamage(pct); // Red modal + 10-second countdown
}
🔄 Part 5: Problems & Solutions
Problems We Faced and Their Solutions
# Problem Solution
1 pip install aiohttp failed due to network Used mirror: pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn
2 localhost opened 0.0.0.0 Used 127.0.0.1 directly
3 ERR_INVALID_RESPONSE Fixed FileResponse path and replaced with Response
4 .html.html (double extension) Used ren in CMD
5 Race condition (Connect/Disconnect loop) Session tokens
6 NASA OVER_RATE_LIMIT Personal key (1000 req/hr)
7 NASA data only reached Station broadcast to devices + stations
8 FLR endpoint 404 Graceful handling (not fatal)
9 Firewall blocking port 8000 netsh advfirewall rule
10 Hotspot AP Isolation USB Tethering / Personal Hotspot
11 Data not updating Broadcast every 5 minutes automatically
12 "AI" and "Blood Pressure" claims Changed to "Expert System" and "CV Risk"
⭐ Part 6: What Makes This Project Unique?
1. Full Transparency (Honesty)
❌ We don't say "AI" — we say "Rule-based Expert System"

❌ We don't say "Blood Pressure" — we say "CV Risk (Estimated)"

❌ We don't say "Satellite" — we say "Phase 3 Planned"

✅ Everything is documented and honest

2. Real NASA Data
5 real RBE events from GOES-P satellite

Each event has an official NASA link

Automatic update every 5 minutes

3. Windowed Delta Detection
Not just static thresholds — we compare 5s vs 5s

Detects deterioration before crossing the limit

4. Transparent Expert System
Every diagnosis is traceable

Clear IF-THEN rules

Not a black box

5. Multi-Device
Multiple astronauts on the same Station

Each device has a separate session

Race-condition-free

6. Closed-Loop Communication
Every message has a Delivery Report

Every command requires an ACK from the astronaut

No lost messages

7. Demo Scenarios
6 ready-to-use scenarios at the click of a button

Nominal, Cardiac, Hull Breach, Wing DMG, Cascade, Solar Storm

8. QR Code Pairing
Instant pairing between devices

Dedicated QR page for each role (Device / Station)

9. Export Report
Export a full JSON report

Includes all data + NASA + AI suggestions

10. Methodology Panel
Transparent page explaining to judges:

Analysis Engine: Rule-based (Not ML)

Forecast: Linear Trend

CV Risk: Estimated

Communication: Local WebSocket

Open Device → http://127.0.0.1:8000/device

Open Station → http://<IP>:8000/station (Password: VITASPACE-2025)
